{{Top|leg}}
The '''Iotran Braceman Council''' was an organization that the individiual [[Alvor Cano]] was a member of. They were a group of elite trackers that were tasked with tracking down criminals outside of [[Iotran Expanse/Legends|Iotran territory]]. They were considered relentless, and often criminals would turn themselves into authorities when they learned a [[Braceman]] was on their trail.<ref name="PP">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref>
